title: Portfolio Open Graph and social-sharing continuity
intent: Make every shared portfolio link carry the current public identity, current page metadata, and a governed photographic card without allowing social previews to drift from the site or expand publication rights.

criteria.criterion: The homepage, metadata, and social card consume one canonical identity; the rendered card selects only the canonical role and name rather than duplicating or rewriting them.
Jamie's name uses the same TeX Gyre Pagella identity face on the site and in the rendered social card, with zero letter spacing and a revisioned v5 preview URL.

The visible role remains in Karla while the identity serif is reserved for Jamie's name; the tagline, site address, photo label, and photographer credit are deliberately absent from the rendered pixels.

The identity face and supporting Karla interface face are delivered from versioned local font assets with upstream records, public licenses, and recorded checksums; no system or resume-embedded proprietary font is republished.
Every route produced by createMetadata carries its current title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph URL, and matching Twitter title and description.
Open Graph and Twitter use the same absolute, revisioned 1200 by 630 image URL, and Twitter declares summary_large_image so a new card revision can invalidate stale platform previews.
The rendered card contains exactly two visible copy blocks—the canonical role and Jamie Burkart—and does not reintroduce the tagline, site address, photo label, or photographer credit.

The role-and-name hierarchy sits over a cinematic left-to-right charcoal gradient that reaches every card edge, remains darkest beneath the copy, and becomes fully transparent before the right-side portrait; the composition contains no vertical rule or floating placard.

The card uses the metadata-stripped East River JPEG source through an explicit social-card placement and Knowledge Wiki projection, with the 1200 by 630 cover treatment recorded as part of the exact occurrence.

The social card uses the approved homepage-aligned full-bleed crop, omits visible in-image credit under Elana Gordon's optional-credit permission, and still records Elana as creator with visible homepage credit and a revocation path.
The Open Graph image has useful alternative text that describes Jamie, the visible public setting, and his current role family.
Public Git and staging approval do not imply production, indexing, a standalone social-media license, or unrestricted reuse of the photograph.
